name: Yorick
notes: No allies, minions, turrets or summoned units exist in this fight, so Yorick's Mist Walkers, the Maiden of the Mist, and Touch of the Maiden (which only triggers from the Maiden's own attacks) never appear; only Yorick's personal actions (basic attacks, Last Rites, Mourning Mist) deal damage here.
R (Eulogy of the Isles) and W (Dark Procession) are never cast: see the `unused` block for why, since neither can produce a damage source in this fight.
The opening move is a normal auto-attack; Last Rites (Q) and Mourning Mist (E) are then each cast the instant they come off cooldown, weaved between attacks.

Last Rites has no cast time: casting it immediately resets Yorick's attack timer and arms his very next attack, so the empowered attack always lands right away; Q's own cooldown only starts once that attack lands, matching the wiki's post-effect cooldown start.
Last Rites' bonus physical damage is treated as unable to critically strike, since no source states it can.

Mourning Mist's damage uses the champion max-health-percent formula (not the minion floor or monster cap) since the dummy counts as an enemy champion, and applies its armor shred at its max rank (25%) since the engine's shred slot holds a single static percent rather than a by-rank list.
Last Rites' self-heal and Mourning Mist's slow/movement-speed bonuses are ignored: healing and crowd control do not affect this fight.
Mana costs are not modeled: none of Yorick's casts are frequent enough at level 16 to run into a mana wall inside a 15 s fight.

assumed.why: the engine's shred slot holds one static percent rather than a by-rank list; used Mourning Mist's max rank (E5) value since a level 16 Yorick typically has E maxed

unused.W: Dark Procession's own tooltip and bin both give it 0 true damage on the enemies it knocks aside; its wall/knockback/terrain are pure positioning and CC that this stationary, non-attacking, non-moving dummy fight ignores entirely, so casting it can never register a damage source.
unused.R: Eulogy of the Isles deals no direct damage itself: all of its offense (the Maiden of the Mist, her Mist Walkers, and the Touch of the Maiden on-hit mark that only arms off the Maiden's own attacks) comes from summoned units, and this fight has no allies/summons modeled at all, so casting R produces no damage source either.
